(1) 设圆柱保持不动，上接触点处于临界滑动状态，则

$$mg\sin\theta - f_{1} - f_{2} = 0$$

$$N_{1}-N_{2}-mg\cos\theta=0$$

$$\begin{cases}(f_2 - f_1)R + N_2(d + D\sin\theta) - N_1(d - D\sin\theta) = 0 \\f_2 = \mu N_2\end{cases}$$

解得

$$f_{1} = \frac{\mu R\sin\theta + \mu D\sin\theta\cos\theta + 2D\sin^{2}\theta - \mu d\cos\theta}{2(D\sin\theta + \mu R)}$$

$$N_{1} = \frac{R\sin\theta + 2\mu R\cos\theta + D\sin\theta\cos\theta + d\cos\theta}{2(D\sin\theta + \mu R)}mg$$

$$N_{2}=\frac{R\sin\theta-D\sin\theta\cos\theta+d\cos\theta}{2(D\sin\theta+\mu R)}mg$$

圆柱保持不动（不滑动、不转动）的条件:

$$\left\{ \begin{aligned} f_{1} \leq \mu N_{1} \\ N_{2} \geq 0 \end{aligned} \right. \Rightarrow \left\{ \begin{aligned} d \geq \frac{D}{\mu} \tan \theta \sin \theta - \mu R = d_{e1} \\ d \geq D \sin \theta - R \tan \theta = d_{e2} \end{aligned} \right.$$

当 $\mu \leq \tan \theta$ 时，$d_{c1} \geq d_{c2}$，故

$$d \geq d_{c1} = \frac{D}{\mu} \tan \theta \sin \theta - \mu R$$

代入几何关系

$$\cos \theta = \frac{r + R}{D}, \sin \theta = \frac{\sqrt{D^{2} - (r + R)^{2}}}{D}, \tan \theta = \frac{\sqrt{D^{2} - (r + R)^{2}}}{r + R}$$

得

$$d_{d,1} = \frac{D^{2} - (r + R)^{2}}{\mu(r + R)} - \mu R$$

当 $\mu > \tan \theta$ 时，$d_{c2} > d_{c1}$，故

$$d \geq d_{c2} = D \sin \theta - R \tan \theta = \frac{r}{r + R} \sqrt{D^2 - (r + R)^2}$$

(2) 圆柱开始滑动后，有

$$\left( ( f _ { 2 } - f _ { 1 } ) R + N _ { 2 } ( x + D \sin \theta ) - N _ { 1 } ( x - D \sin \theta ) = 0 \right.$$

$$mg\sin\theta-f_{1}-f_{2}=ma$$

$$N_{1}-N_{2}-mg\cos\theta=0$$

$$f_{1} = \mu N_{1}, \quad f_{2} = \mu N_{2}$$

解得

$$a = g \sin \theta - \frac{\mu g(x + \mu R)}{D \tan \theta}$$

初始时 $x = d$，加速度为

$$a_{0} = g\sin\theta - \frac{\mu g(d + \mu R)}{D\tan\theta} = \frac{\sqrt{D^{2} - (r + R)^{2}}}{D}\left[1 - \frac{\mu(d + \mu R)(r + R)}{(D^{2} - (r + R)^{2})}\right]g$$

由 $a = v \frac{dv}{dx}$ 得

$$\int_{0}^{v} m v d v = \int_{d}^{d+\Delta d} a d x = \int_{d}^{d+\Delta d} \left[ g \sin \theta - \frac{\mu g(x+\mu R)}{D \tan \theta} \right] d x$$

积分得

$$\frac{1}{2}mv^{2}=\frac{\Delta d}{D\tan\theta}\left[gD\sin\theta\tan\theta-\mu^{2}gR-\mu gd-\frac{1}{2}\mu g\Delta d\right]$$

令 $\frac{1}{2}mv^{2}=0$，解得最大位移

$$\Delta d=2\left(\frac{D\sin\theta\tan\theta}{\mu}-\mu R-d\right)=2\left[\frac{D^{2}-(r+R)^{2}}{\mu(r+R)}-\mu R-d\right]$$

(3) 圆柱同时发生转动时，有

$$\int ( f _ { 2 } - f _ { 1 } ) R + N _ { 2 } ( d + D \sin \theta ) - N _ { 1 } ( d - D \sin \theta ) = 0$$

$$mg\sin\theta - f_{1} - f_{2} = ma$$

$$N_{1}-N_{2}-mg\cos\theta=0$$

$$f_{1}r=J\beta_{1}, \quad f_{2}r=J\beta_{2}, \quad a=r\beta_{1}=r\beta_{2}$$

解得

$$\beta_{1}=\beta_{2}=\frac{mgr\sin\theta}{2J+mr^{2}}$$

$$N_{1} = \frac{J\sin\theta + d + D\sin\theta}{2D\tan\theta}mg, \quad N_{2} = \frac{J\sin\theta - d + D\sin\theta}{2D\tan\theta}mg$$
